title: Epic (tabletop game) — The Cold Version #Shorts
description:
The honest version of Epic (tabletop game) starts by giving up the comforting part. Epic is a collective term for a series of tabletop wargames by Games Workshop set in their fictional Warhammer 40,000 universe. Whereas Warhammer 40,000 involves small battles between forces of a few squads of troops and two or three vehicles, Epic features battles between armies consisting of hundreds of soldiers, dozens of tanks, and giant war machines.

Every serious account of Epic (tabletop game) eventually collides with the question of who is deciding. Armies for other races included the Imperial Guard, Eldar (studio armies were the Biel-Tan and Iyanden Craftworlds), and Tyranids. Imperial players had a choice of Space Marines or Imperial Guard, with support from Titan Legions.
